title: OFDM Modulator
text: Modulate frequency-domain OFDM subcarriers to time-domain samples for custom communication protocols, 8 inputs, 3 outputs, {Rounding Method} sets Rounding mode for internal fixed-point calculations; {OFDM parameters source} sets the source of OFDM, {Maximum FFT length} sets the maximum length of FFT length, {FFT length} sets the length of FFT, {Cyclic prefix length} sets the length of cyclic prefix, {Number of left guard subcarriers} sets the number of guard band subcarriers in left extreme of OFDM, {Number of right guard subcarriers} sets the number of guard band subcarriers in right extreme of OFDM, {Insert DC Null} sets the option to insert DC null, {Enable reset input port} sets the reset signal, {Windowing} sets the spectral growth reduction, {Window length} sets the length of window, {Maximum window length} sets the maximum length of window and {Divide butterfly outputs by two} sets the divide FFT butterfly outputs by two. Values come from the instance.
